name: tefsira-sanahi-api
description: The Laravel API needs no frontend build. This file lets hosting deploy scripts that run `npm ci && npm run build` (e.g. Laravel Forge's default) succeed. The website (React) lives in web/ and the dashboard in dashboard/, each with its own package.json; the website is published with web/tool/deploy.ps1.

scripts.build: echo "API only: no frontend assets to build"
